skills.name: Strawberry Fields
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Activates when entering Full Burst. Affects self. DEF ▲ 15.12% for 10 sec. ■ Activates when attacked during Full Burst. Affects self. Restores HP equal to 7.56% of the skill user's final max HP.

skills.name: Sweet Strawberry Goodness
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Activates after landing 100 normal attacks. Affects self. Strawberry Candy: Max Ammunition Capacity ▲ 28.35%. Stacks up to 10 times and lasts for 10 sec. ■ Activates when Strawberry Candy is at max stacks. Removes all stacks and affects all allies. Reloads 43.31% of the magazine.

skills.name: Strawberry Shock
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Affects 5 enemy unit(s) with the highest final ATK. Deals 154.19% of final ATK as damage. Taunt for 2.53 sec.
